blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A one-year-old boy died Friday night, Nov. 13, after fire razed his family’s house in Carmona City, Cavite. The Police Regional Office 4A said in a report Saturday that the blaze broke out in Barangay Milagrosa at 9:45 p.m. According to the police, the boy’s mother left him in the care of her two other young children while she went to a neighbor’s house before dinner. While their mother was away, the two children reportedly lit a candle and placed it inside the room where their younger brother was sleeping. The two then went outside to play, leaving […]...
